Questions 1–10

Complete the form below.

Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER in each gap.

CRIME REPORT FORM

CRIME REPORT FORM
Type of crime: theft Personal information
Example Name Louise Taylor
  • Nationality Date of birth 14 December 1977 Occupation interior designer Reason for visit business (to buy antique ) Length of stay two months Current address Apartments (No 15) Details of theft Items stolen - a wallet containing approximately ￡ - a Date of theft
  • Possible time and place of theft Location outside the at about 4 pm Details of suspect - some boys asked for the then ran off - one had a T-shirt with a picture of a tiger - he was about 12, slim build with hair Crime reference number allocated

transcript.en: Good morning. What can I do for you?
transcript.zh: 早上好。我能为你做什么？

transcript.en: I want to report a theft. I had some things stolen out of my bag yesterday.
transcript.zh: 我要举报一起偷窃案。昨天我包里有些东西被偷了。

transcript.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Right, so I'll need to take a few details. Can I start with your name?
transcript.zh: 很遗憾听到这个消息。好吧，我需要了解一些细节。我能从你的名字开始吗？

transcript.en: Louise Taylor.
transcript.zh: 路易斯·泰勒。

transcript.en: OK, thank you. And are you resident in the UK?
transcript.zh: 好的，谢谢。你是英国居民吗？

transcript.en: No, I'm actually Canadian, though my mother was British.
transcript.zh: 不，我其实是加拿大人，尽管我的母亲是英国人。

transcript.en: And your date of birth?
transcript.zh: 那你的出生日期呢？

transcript.en: December 14th, 1977.
So you're just visiting this country?
transcript.zh: 那你是来这个国家访问吗？

transcript.en: That's right. I come over most summers on business. I'm an interior designer and I come over to buy old furniture, antiques you know.
transcript.zh: 没错。我大多数夏天都是来出差的。我是一个室内设计师，我来这里采购旧家具，古董，你知道的。

transcript.en: There are some really lovely things around here, but you need to get out to the small towns. I've had a really good trip this year, until this happened.
transcript.zh: 这周围有一些非常可爱的事物，但你需要去到那些小城镇。直到这件事发生之前，我今年的旅行真的很不错。

transcript.en: OK. So you've been here quite a while?
transcript.zh: 我明白了。所以你在这里有一段时间了？

transcript.en: Yes, I'm here for two months. I go back next week.
transcript.zh: 是的，我要在这里待两个月。我下周就回去了。

transcript.en: So may I ask where you're staying now?
transcript.zh: 请问你现在住哪儿？

transcript.en: Well at present I've got a place at Park Apartments, that's on King Street.
transcript.zh: 现在我在国王街的公园公寓落脚。

transcript.en: I was staying at the Riverside Apartments on the same street, but the apartment there was only available for six weeks so I had to find another one.
transcript.zh: 之前我住在同一条街上的河岸公寓里，但是那里的公寓只有六个星期的租期，所以我只能另找一间。

transcript.en: OK. And the apartment number?
transcript.zh: 好的。公寓号码呢？

transcript.en: Fifteen.
Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Now, I need to take some details of the theft. So you said you had some things stolen out of your bag?
transcript.zh: 现在，我需要了解一些这起偷窃的细节。你说你的包里有东西被偷了？

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 没错。

transcript.en: And were you actually carrying the bag when the theft took place?
transcript.zh: 偷窃发生时，你确实带着你的包吗？

transcript.en: Yes. I really can't understand it. I had my backpack on. And I went into a supermarket to buy a few things and when I opened it up my wallet wasn't there.
transcript.zh: 是的。我真的不明白。我背着我的背包，然后去超市买了一些东西，但当我打开它的时候，我的钱包却不在了。

transcript.en: And what did your wallet have in it?
transcript.zh: 你的钱包里有什么？

transcript.en: Well, fortunately I don't keep my credit cards in that wallet - I keep them with my passport in an inside compartment in my backpack.
transcript.zh: 好吧，幸好我没有把信用卡放在钱包里--我把它们和护照放在背包里的一个夹层里。

transcript.en: But there was quite a bit of cash there...about ￡250 sterling, I should think.
transcript.zh: 但那里有相当一部分现金，大概有250英镑。

transcript.en: I withdrew ￡300 from my account yesterday, but I did a bit of shopping, so I must have already spent about ￡50 of that.
transcript.zh: 我昨天从我的账户里取出了300英镑，但我买了点东西，所以我一定花了大约50英镑。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: At first I thought, oh I must have left the wallet back in the apartment, but then I realised my phone had gone as well.
transcript.zh: 一开始我想，噢，我一定是把钱包忘在公寓里了，但后来我意识到我的手机也不见了。

transcript.en: It was only a week old, and that's when I realised I'd been robbed. Anyway at least they didn't take the keys to my rental car.
transcript.zh: 这手机才买了一周，然后我就意识到自己被抢了。不过至少他们没有拿走我租的车的钥匙。

transcript.en: Yes. So you say the theft occurred yesterday?
transcript.zh: 好的。你说你是昨天被偷的？

transcript.en: Yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: So that was September the tenth. And do you have any idea at all of where or when the things might possibly have been stolen?
transcript.zh: 所以那是九月十日。你知道这些东西可能在哪里或什么时候被偷吗？

transcript.en: Well at first I couldn't believe it because the bag had been on my back ever since I left the apartment after lunch.
transcript.zh: 一开始我不敢相信，因为自从我午饭后离开公寓，包就一直在我背上。

transcript.en: It's just a small backpack, but I generally use it when I'm travelling because it seems safer than a handbag. Anyway, I met up with a friend, and we spent a couple of hours in the museum.
transcript.zh: 这只是一个小背包，但我通常在旅行时用它，因为它看起来比手提包安全。我遇到了一个朋友，我们在博物馆逛了几小时。

transcript.en: But I do remember that as we were leaving there, at about 4 o'clock, a group of young boys ran up to us, and they were really crowding round us, and they were asking us what time it was, then all of a sudden they ran off.
transcript.zh: 但我记得，当我们离开那里的时候，大约在4点钟，一群年轻的男孩跑过来，他们挤在我们周围，问我们现在是什么时候，接着他们突然就跑了。

transcript.en: Can you remember anything about them?
transcript.zh: 你还记得关于他们的任何特征吗？

transcript.en: The one who did most of the talking was wearing a T-shirt with a picture of something...let's see... a tiger.
transcript.zh: 那个说话最多的人穿着一件印着某样东西的T恤……让我想想……一只老虎。

transcript.en: Right. Any idea of how old he might have been?
transcript.zh: 好。你知道他大概多大了吗？

transcript.en: Around twelve years old?
transcript.zh: 大约12岁？

transcript.en: And can you remember anything else about his appearance?
transcript.zh: ]你还能想起什么他的外貌特征吗？

transcript.en: Not much. He was quite thin...
transcript.zh: 记不太清了。他很瘦……

transcript.en: Colour of hair?
transcript.zh: 发色呢？

transcript.en: I do remember that - he was blond. All the others were dark-haired.
transcript.zh: 这我还记得，他是金发。其他人都是黑头发。

transcript.en: And any details of the others?
transcript.zh: 还有关于其他人的细节吗？

transcript.en: Not really. They came and went so quickly.
transcript.zh: 不太记得了。他们来得太快也跑得太快。

transcript.en: Right. So what I'm going to do now is give you a crime reference number so you can contact your insurance company.
transcript.zh: 好的。现在我要给你一个犯罪参考号码，这样你就可以联系你的保险公司了。

transcript.en: So this is ten digits: 87954 82361
Thank you. So should I ...
transcript.zh: 谢谢。那么我应该...
